prod.statement: For arbitrary types $\Omega$, $S$, $T$ and functions $X:\Omega\to S$, $Y:\Omega\to T$, this defines the function $\langle X,Y\rangle:\Omega\to S\times T$ given by $\langle X,Y\rangle(\omega)=(X(\omega),Y(\omega))$ for every $\omega\in\Omega$. According to its docstring, it is the pair of the two random variables $X$ and $Y$.
